This document outlines the equipment major maintenance 
list P1, which must be performed for the high pressure steam turbine by-pass 
valve every five years as indicated by Y5 in the above titled block

The high pressure steam turbine by-pass valve is a 
station for reduction the steam pressure and temperature outlets from the main 
steam of high pressure steam boiler to very low pressure and temperature which 
be able to get in the condenser.

items:
Unscrew all bolts (5.1) and packings (5.2), remove 
 flange (5.3).

Loosen and remove nozzle holder (5), spacer ring 
 (5.4) and packing (5.5) by mounting one of bolts (5.1)in the center hole of 
 the nozzle holder and pull out the nozzle holder.

Release the locking of the nozzle (4) by bending 
 back the lock washer (5.6) and unscrew the nozzle.

Inspect the cracks in the valve interior. If there, 
 remove them by grinding and recheck with fluid penetrate test (the limit of 
 cracks is 3 mm).

Remove by lapping with cast iron disc any small 
 impressions in the seat sealing surface resulting from clamped-in foreign 
 particles.

Check corrosion inside the valve. If there, remove 
 it by cleaning with no corrosive products or by lapping with cast iron disc.

Inspect the valve seat, if there is any damages or 
 cracks, retreat it by grinding or machining.

Replace the valve seat if it cannot be 
 reconditioning.

Check the valve bonnet for damages and treat it by 
 grinding or machining.
Inspect packing (13) and replace it if required.
Replace the stuffing box (14) in case of leakage.
Replace the stem guide (8) if it is required.
Put a new gasket (6) in the spray nozzle.

Replace the packing (5.5) in the spray nozzle if it 
 is required.
Clean all parts before assembly.
Change the plug.

Clean the silencer by air hose, then by solar and 
 rags.

Rub all sliding surfaces carefully with a cloth 
 containing suitable lubricant (Molycote).
Install the plug (12) in bonnet (7).
Install the stem guide (8) in bonnet (7).

Insert new stem packing rings (14).
 ► Do not overfill gland with packing rings. Leave at 
 least height of one ring free to accept gland bush (15).

Insert gland bush (15), gland nut (16) and snap ring 
 (17). Tighten gland nut slightly.
 ► Do not over tighten the gland nut.

Secure stem from dropping through packing box by 
 inserting a pin through the hole in the stem.

Lift the complete bonnet assembly with the stem / 
 plug and slide it carefully into the valve body.

Inspect pressure seal gasket.
 ►Be sure that the stem / plug sets accurately on the 
 valve seat.
Insert spacer ring (20) and segment (19).
Mount cover plate (18).
Screw the bolts (21).

Mount the actuator yoke by means of bolts (22) and 
 tighten them.

Assemble the nozzle (4) and nozzle holder (5),

Put a new gasket (6) on nozzle holder (5) and insert

 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment major maintenance 
list P1, which must be performed for the high pressure steam turbine by-pass 
valve every five years as indicated by Y5 in the above titled block
The high pressure steam turbine by-pass valve is a 
station for reduction the steam pressure and temperature outlets from the main 
steam of high pressure steam boiler to very low pressure and temperature which 
be able to get in the condenser.
Technical Specifications
Manufacturer | : | BTG Kalle Sweden.
Type | : | VLR 140T.
Medium | : | Steam.
Inlet Pressure | : | 70 bars.
Outlet Pressure | : | 15 bars.
Inlet Temperature | : | 513 
 C.
Outlet Temperature | : | 485 
 C.
Actuator | : | Hydraulic.
Dimensions (plug 
 stroke) | : | 140 
 112 
 mm.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem, tested by eng. Essam Darwish, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng 
Samir Abd El Gilil; approved by eng. Mohamed Anan general 
director

of Damieeta PS.

 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Isolate the by-pass valve mechanically and electrically.
Be sure that the steam boiler is shutdown.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Spray.
Wires for lifting.
Cleaning articles.
Filler.
Work to be Carried out
Before disassembly, you must measure the by-pass 
 stroke and record it.
Disassembly
Unscrew all bolts (5.1) and packings (5.2), remove 
 flange (5.3).
Loosen and remove nozzle holder (5), spacer ring 
 (5.4) and packing (5.5) by mounting one of bolts (5.1)in the center hole of 
 the nozzle holder and pull out the nozzle holder.
Release the locking of the nozzle (4) by bending 
 back the lock washer (5.6) and unscrew the nozzle.
Inspection
Inspect the cracks in the valve interior. If there, 
 remove them by grinding and recheck with fluid penetrate test (the limit of 
 cracks is 3 mm).
Remove by lapping with cast iron disc any small 
 impressions in the seat sealing surface resulting from clamped-in foreign 
 particles.
Check corrosion inside the valve. If there, remove 
 it by cleaning with no corrosive products or by lapping with cast iron disc.
Inspect the valve seat, if there is any damages or 
 cracks, retreat it by grinding or machining.
Replace the valve seat if it cannot be 
 reconditioning.
Check the valve bonnet for damages and treat it by 
 grinding or machining.
Inspect packing (13) and replace it if required.
Replace the stuffing box (14) in case of leakage.
Replace the stem guide (8) if it is required.
Put a new gasket (6) in the spray nozzle.
Replace the packing (5.5) in the spray nozzle if it 
 is required.
Clean all parts before assembly.
Change the plug.
Clean the silencer by air hose, then by solar and 
 rags.
Rub all sliding surfaces carefully with a cloth 
 containing suitable lubricant (Molycote).
Assembly
Install the plug (12) in bonnet (7).
Install the stem guide (8) in bonnet (7).
Insert new stem packing rings (14).
 ► Do not overfill gland with packing rings. Leave at 
 least height of one ring free to accept gland bush (15).
Insert gland bush (15), gland nut (16) and snap ring 
 (17). Tighten gland nut slightly.
 ► Do not over tighten the gland nut.
Secure stem from dropping through packing box by 
 inserting a pin through the hole in the stem.
Lift the complete bonnet assembly with the stem / 
 plug and slide it carefully into the valve body.
Inspect pressure seal gasket.
 ►Be sure that the stem / plug sets accurately on the 
 valve seat.
Insert spacer ring (20) and segment (19).
Mount cover plate (18).
Screw the bolts (21).
Mount the actuator yoke by means of bolts (22) and 
 tighten them.
Assemble the Spray Nozzle as Follows:
Assemble the nozzle (4) and nozzle holder (5), 
 secure the nozzle with spacer ring (5.6)
Put a new gasket (6) on nozzle holder (5) and insert 
 nozzle stud (5.7)
Replace packing (5.5), mount them together with 
 spacer ring (5.4) and fit flange (5.3) with bolts (5.1).
Install the actuator of the valve.
Check the alignment between actuator and valve stem.
Tight the coupling bolts firmly.
Mount the hydraulic and pneumatic connections.
Mount the electrical connections.
